title: Network Configuration
description: Manage physical Ethernet interfaces, IP assignment, and default gateway routes with two-phase safe rollback watchdog protection.

actions.goToNewIp: Go to New Address to Confirm

discoveredInterfaces: {{count}} physical Ethernet interfaces detected · Safe rollback watchdog enabled

editDialog.title: Configure Interface: {{name}}
editDialog.applySuccess: Interface {{name}} configuration applied. Entering trial run.
editDialog.description: Change IP allocation mode, static address, and default gateway. Two-phase watchdog ensures configuration safety.
editDialog.highRiskDesc: This interface is the current management inbound adapter. If the IP is changed, your connection will disconnect immediately. You must confirm within 60s at the new IP, or the system will roll back!
editDialog.dnsDesc: Separate multiple DNS addresses with commas or spaces
editDialog.defaultGwDesc: All non-local outbound traffic will route through this interface

watchdog.bannerText: A trial network configuration is active. It will automatically roll back in {{countdown}} seconds.
watchdog.modalTitle: Network Configuration in Trial Run (Watchdog Active)
watchdog.modalDesc: The system applied the new network settings and entered a 60-second trial observation period. If not confirmed, settings will roll back automatically.
watchdog.migrationAlert: Management interface IP has changed! This session will disconnect. Please complete confirmation at the new IP address as soon as possible.
watchdog.trialActiveDesc: If network connectivity is normal, click [Confirm & Persist] before countdown expires. If disconnected or broken, the system will safely restore original settings.
watchdog.confirmSuccess: Network configuration confirmed and persisted successfully!
watchdog.rollbackSuccess: Network configuration safely rolled back to previous state
watchdog.notice: If confirmation is not completed before the countdown ends, the host will automatically restore previous network settings to prevent disconnection.
watchdog.expiredDesc: Watchdog triggered automatic rollback. The host network is restoring previous configuration. Please refresh or verify connectivity shortly.
